_meta.feature: Regulatory Monitoring (P5) — global reference catalog that feeds the typeahead 'assign a reference' search
_meta.purpose: GLOBAL master list of regulations, laws and standards. This is the search index a user selects from when assigning a reference to a product/project/process, and the 'add an additional reference' autocomplete source. It is NOT tenant data — per-tenant applicability lives in regulatory_monitoring.json.
_meta.maps_to_screen: Regulatory Monitoring → Assign Reference typeahead / Reference Library. Mockup pending.
_meta.target_markets: Tunisia/MENA export sector → primary export destinations EU, US, GCC. Catalog covers domestic (Tunisia), the export jurisdictions, and the international/harmonisation bodies those markets recognise.
_meta.legal_boundary_note: Per Open Regulations Analysis §2/§3.8: public law/regulation/directive/decree text is free to ingest & AI-analyze (legal_status=INGESTIBLE). Private technical standards (ISO/IEC/EN/ASTM/GSO/national NT standards) are copyrighted — Qurelio may list the number + scope for selection/monitoring only, never host or AI-analyze the text (legal_status=REFERENCE_ONLY); the tenant may upload their OWN licensed copy under a liability shift. National gazette texts with unconfirmed reuse licensing (Tunisia JORT, MENA) are user-uploaded under a liability shift (legal_status=USER_UPLOAD).
_meta.count_note: Curated holistic seed. Some standard families are collapsed to one entry (e.g. the ISO 10993 series, ICH Q3 impurity family). Verify [VERIFY] flags before production — mainly Tunisian decree numbers and reuse-licensing status.

schema.regulation_id: Stable internal id. REG-/DIR-/CFR-/LAW-/DEC-/STD-/ICH-/WHO-/GSO-/NT- prefixes by type.
schema.reference: Canonical citation shown as the primary result label.
schema.short_code: The token a user is most likely to type (e.g. 'MDR', 'ISO 13485', '21 CFR 211').
schema.title: Full official name.
schema.aliases: Extra search terms — synonyms, numbers without prefix, and FR terms — so the typeahead matches partial input in EN or FR.
schema.type: Regulation | Directive | Law | Decree | Order/Circular | Guideline | Standard | Pharmacopoeia | Technical Regulation
schema.country_region: EU | US | TN | GCC | SA | INT | ICH | WHO — used for filter chips.
schema.category: Functional grouping for the results list.
schema.legal_status: INGESTIBLE | REFERENCE_ONLY | USER_UPLOAD — drives the engine capability + upload flow.
schema.engine_capability: One-line UI string explaining what the engine may do with this reference.
schema.source: Where the free text (if any) comes from.

legal_status_legend.INGESTIBLE: Public legal text. Qurelio ingests the full text and runs the compliance engine on it directly.
legal_status_legend.REFERENCE_ONLY: Copyrighted paid standard. Selectable for monitoring/assignment; Qurelio shows number + scope only. To analyze, the tenant uploads their OWN licensed copy (liability shift).
legal_status_legend.USER_UPLOAD: Reuse licensing unconfirmed (national gazettes / MENA). Not hosted by Qurelio; the tenant uploads the text and accepts full legal liability before analysis.
